notes.title: Crucial Hotfix for grevious error
notes.notes:
I've made one typo in the current release, literally just one word misspelled, and it could permanently damage your project if you start it. 
Please restart Steam, before launching it the next time.

If you have been affected by this issue, which you will know because your project will have
1. crashed
2. failed to start

Message me personally on Discord (Folling#9999) or send me an email (contact@folling.de) and I will fix the project up for you - however, some of the data will be unrecoverable.

I made a joke about this happening a few minutes before this issues was reported, I should stop jinxing it.

Terribly sorry for the inconvenience, and I pray that no one has lost any significant amount of progress.

This also includes a fix, where text from the information tab entered in the previous version wouldn't be rendered in the new one. This is however fully recoverable for any project, in case you were affected.

sincerely,
Folling - Dev and Community Manager

notes.title: Version 2.1 beta release
notes.notes:
greetings.jpg

Here we go again, this time with a release that drastically improves the text-editor functionality, and the overall look by Ikarus by providing icons!

[b]Important Note[/b]
We had a bug in the previous release, where colours would be duplicated with each new launch. This has been fixed, but in the process, all colour-values (just colour ones, everything else is intact) have been reset. I apologise for the inconvenience.

For anyone who didn't like the text-based tutorial, we now have a short video (8m56s) version, which you can check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9w5pEBL1QmM]here[/url]!

The full patch-notes for this release can be found [url=https://gist.github.com/Folling/de81b34219b9d4d7f2812d115a6bb0ed]here[/url].

A big thanks as always to our patrons who make sure that we can continue working on Ikarus!

The next release will be quite technical in nature, and might take some time to be stable, but stay tuned, especially if you're a developer yourself.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/ikarus]Discord[/url] for more frequent updates, or just to chat with us!

Happy building!
Folling, Dev and Community Manager

notes.title: Linux Hotfix
notes.notes:
We noticed that some people were having issues running Ikarus on Linux. 
After some investigation we found a small but non-trivial issue that we overlooked in our initial release, which has since been fixed.

We've tested Ikarus on various distributions, and it seems to be running better than ever.
However: If you still experience any issues on Linux, please let us know in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1039110/discussions/1/1629665087682822642/]this[/url] thread, or ping us on [url=https://discord.gg/ikarus]Discord[/url].

More content updates are coming within the next few days, so stay tuned!

See you around,
FADED - DevOps

notes.title: Important update for the next version
notes.notes:
Heya all,

a bit of a downer for this one:
As we announced last time, Ikarus is going through some huge changes right now, this means that a lot of the things in the code-base will be fundamentally different. 

We have thusly decided that the next release - whenever it will go live - will be a breaking one. 
Breaking here means that previous projects won't be supported in the newer version anymore.

This was decided through a mix of analysing our playtime statistics, and talking through it for some time. 

We're very sorry if any of you have some progress that would be worth saving, though we do urge you to get in touch with us, and we will look for a solution on a user-to-user basis. 
Contact: 
- Discord (Folling#9999)
- E-mail (info@ikarus.world)

This will not happen frequently. We have a system in place that allows us to adapt the save files to newer versions though this version has so many fundamental changes adapting everything would take weeks, be extremely prone to errors and would need to linger in our codebase for months to come. I cannot promise that this is the last time this will happen (we are in early beta still) but it's very unlikely that it will. 

I will keep you posted, if we ever decide to finalise our decision on when we will guarantee a permanent safety for projects!

A positive side-note:
I have pondered a lot about Ikarus' layout and design and have come up with a layout that I believe to be a few orders of magnitude better than the current one, which will be part of the next release as well, so look forward to that!

Sincerely,
Folling - Dev and Community Manager

notes.title: A short update on the development process
notes.notes:
Hey all!

We usually only talk about these things on our Discord, so for those of you which aren't on there, it might seem as if we're being very dead, which is neither the case, nor do we want to leave the impression that that's the case!

I have a long post regarding the details on our server, though here's a rundown of why updates have become less frequent:
We're currently trying to prepare a lot for the future, this includes, but isn't limited to:
[list]
[*] Figuring out how to properly store Ikarus' data, both in an efficient/performant and accessible way
[*] Setting up for HiDPI, including a better Font
[*] Setting up some more OS specific tasks, such as actually displaying our icon
[*] Switching our rendering backend to older versions of DirectX/OpenGL to support older computers
[*] Implementing Mac support
[/list]

None of these features warrant a release on their own in our opinion, so we will group them all together in one big tech-update release in the near future.

Thanks for your patience!
Folling - Dev and Community Manager

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we've worked hard this weekend to release version 1.1

Let's start with some important information first:
Your old project will not be available per default in ikarus anymore. You'll see why in the patchnotes. If you had any progress that you think is worthwhile saving here's a guide:

[list]
[*] Open Ikarus
[*] Create a Project
[*] Close Ikarus
[*] Go to ${steam}/steamapps/common/Ikarus
[*] cut the "test.db" file

WINDOWS:
[*] go to %appdata%/ikarus/projects/Project

LINUX:
[*] go to ~/.config/ikarus/projects/Project

[*] delete the data.db file
[*] paste your test.db file
[*] rename it to data.db
[/list]

and you're done should you struggle with this, or should it fail for you, message me on Discord: Folling#9999

We've temporarily removed macOS support, as there's an issue with getting Ikarus to run on it.

We're also aware of some problems on older systems, with older graphics drivers. 

[u][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/u]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented Project Feature - have multiple projects, one for each world/universe and switch freely between them!
[*] Implemented Colour Theme - You can now change most of the colours in Ikarus, should you not like the default theme. However - the colours are currently not saved, so you would have to re-set it every time you start Ikarus. This is mostly just to collect feedback for now. Thanks for MetroAndroid for the suggestion!
[*] Created the About Page to show love to our Supporters and the OSS licenses of awesome projects we depend on
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Using a Colour in a representation no longer crashes Ikarus - thanks to 
am18carpenter for the find!
[*] Using Constraints for Selectables/ReferenceLists no longer crashes Ikarus
[*] Any Entities (Blueprints, Attributes, Representations, Instances) are now displayed in the order they were created in, previously adding many of them would reshuffle them
[*] Range Constraints are now working properly
[*] Ranges can now be represented properly
[*] Representations no longer add an unnecessary space after the last part's postfix
[*] Deleting Entities no longer prohibits you from adding new ones
[/list]

[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Instance Attributes" Button for Instances was reduced in size and had its text changed to "Values" - it still does the same thing, but leaves more space for representations, and seems more obvious
[*] Blueprint's Instances are now just called {blueprint_name}s
So for Character it would show "Characters", this obviously is terrible for internationalisation and irregular nouns, and we'll work on that once we include translations, however this will do for now.
[*] Instance-Attribute windows no longer display ${representation} Instance-Attributes, but rather just ${representation}

notes.title: Updates on the release-date
notes.notes:
Hello once again!

I bring more sorrow news:
We haven't yet received the green light by steam (get it?) to release, and at this point it's anyone's guess when we will do so. It might be five minutes after I post this announcement, it might be tomorrow, though due to the weekend - it might also just be Monday.

The program is pretty much in a releasable state at this point, so we're mostly playing the waiting game and fleshing out bugs where we find some. 

I should also note that there have been some changes in Ikarus ever since the screenshots were taken, though I'll post an extensive list of features and changes once we release. 
I'll reschedule the release date for tomorrow - same time, for now. However please note that this is currently majorly outside of our control. 

Thanks for the elaborate patience, and until the release
Folling, Dev and Community Manager.

PS:
The keen ones among you will notice that the release date says "16.07" instead of tomorrow. That's just some Steam shenanigan going on, but again - at this point I can't say when we'll release.

notes.title: Release date delayed unto the 11th of July 2019
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to the first announcement!

Sadly it isn't a positive one: 
The steam servers were under heavy load due to the summer sale these past days and we were unable to upload the game's files to steam.
There's a required time for steam to make sure our game is not some evil virus and so, to take all these things into account, Ikarus' release will have to be delayed by one more week.

Thank you all for your patience!
Folling - Dev and Community Manager
